evals.prompt: Plan the design deliverables for a 300px browser-extension popup with account status and a connect button. The project already uses Vue and its component library. Cover empty, loading and connected states. Available capabilities: edit Vue components, run the existing preview and inspect it in a browser. No design integration is connected.
evals.expected_output: A scoped artifact-selection and inspection plan matching available capabilities without mandatory unrelated files.
assertions: Uses the existing Vue component/preview path as the visual deliverable rather than requiring a duplicate standalone HTML mock.
Does not require multiple pages, an application shell, separate theme files or ASCII wireframes for this one surface.
Records relevant states and real width, editable artifact location, opening instructions and planned rendered inspection without claiming it already occurred.

evals.prompt: Plan deliverables to explain sign-in, invalid-password recovery and successful entry for a product review. We need a flow diagram maintained alongside repository Markdown. Available capabilities: file editing, Mermaid CLI mmdc, and image viewing; no cloud integrations are connected.
evals.expected_output: A scoped artifact-selection and inspection plan matching available capabilities without mandatory unrelated files.
assertions: Selects Mermaid editable source or a Mermaid Markdown block for this flow diagram.
Includes a local render and visual inspection step with the available CLI/viewer, and does not imply Markdown source alone proves rendering.
Does not require HTML, screen wireframes, both theme modes or a five-file suite to explain the flow.

evals.prompt: Plan an editable spatial sketch to compare navigation arrangements for a settings panel. Available capabilities: local file editing, the official Excalidraw CLI, an installed Chromium executable and image viewing. Python and uv are not installed. Keep work local; project brand colors are already defined in the brand skill.
evals.expected_output: A scoped artifact-selection and inspection plan matching available capabilities without mandatory unrelated files.
assertions: Selects editable .excalidraw source and a local PNG preview using the official excalidraw render command.
Uses project brand values and preserves editable content; does not require upstream colors or fonts.
Does not require Python/uv, an upload/account, a second page or a replacement HTML mock; distinguishes planned inspection from performed inspection.
